title: Find the Closest Palindrome
algorithm: Mirror the leading half and its adjacent values; include digit-length boundaries, exclude the input, and break ties toward the smaller candidate.

complexity.time: O(d) string work plus a constant number of exact d-digit arithmetic operations; d <= 18
